basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old new dad living in Southern California, juggling life between work as a freelance graphic designer and being a full-time parent. I have a passion for humor and love sharing jokes to brighten up people's days. When I'm not working or spending time with my family, you'll find me exploring new fast-food joints or catching up on my favorite sports teams. My online hours are usually late at night when the baby's asleep. I'm currently married and navigating the fun chaos of early parenthood.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and a knack for creating visual content. My sense of humor is largely self-taught, honed by years of watching stand-up comedy and reading joke books. I have a keen interest in fast food culture, which I follow closely through various online communities.
